cases.injectAt: HTTP operation persistence before commit
cases.requiredState: no confirmed operation; same-ID retry creates one operation
cases.assertion: accepted operation count is zero before commit and one after retry
cases.cleanup: remove isolated database and test process

cases.injectAt: Host command accepted, daemon receipt lost
cases.requiredState: original command remains queryable and is not executed twice
cases.assertion: one durable command record and one execution identity after reconnect
cases.cleanup: stop test Host and remove isolated log

cases.injectAt: child process starts before start-complete receipt persists
cases.requiredState: START_UNKNOWN bound to original Host; no second attempt
cases.assertion: recovery finds original process or retains unknown state
cases.cleanup: verified test process-tree teardown

cases.injectAt: concurrent same-ID requests with different fingerprints
cases.requiredState: one accepted request and one explicit conflict
cases.assertion: database transaction and unique constraint reject the conflicting request
cases.cleanup: remove isolated database

cases.injectAt: concurrent different-ID starts for one task
cases.requiredState: at most one unclosed attempt
cases.assertion: database constraint rejects a second active attempt under concurrency
cases.cleanup: remove isolated database and test process

cases.injectAt: dependency or cancellation changes while queued
cases.requiredState: stale work is rejected before external side effects
cases.assertion: revalidation runs immediately before dispatch
cases.cleanup: remove isolated database and temporary worktree

cases.injectAt: stop reaches executor that ignores cooperative cancellation
cases.requiredState: STOPPING retains reservation until verified termination
cases.assertion: reservation is not released before exit proof
cases.cleanup: terminate only the test-owned process tree and verify exit

cases.injectAt: daemon or Host disconnects during stop
cases.requiredState: STOP_UNKNOWN until reconciliation proves exit
cases.assertion: reconnect continues the same stop operation without a new attempt
cases.cleanup: reconnect test Host, then use verified teardown

cases.injectAt: PID reuse or mismatched Host epoch
cases.requiredState: no attach, kill, or state mutation of the unrelated process
cases.assertion: full process and Host identity validation rejects the mismatch
cases.cleanup: remove isolated identity fixtures

cases.injectAt: daemon SIGTERM and SIGKILL while a managed Host runs
cases.requiredState: same Host reconnects with events replayed and no implicit approval
cases.assertion: Host identity is stable and critical events are present exactly once after import
cases.cleanup: stop test Host and verify its child tree exited

cases.injectAt: test Host SIGKILL
cases.requiredState: controlled process tree is reconciled; indeterminate external effects stay unknown
cases.assertion: verified process exit or MANUAL_REQUIRED is recorded without false success
cases.cleanup: verify all test-owned descendants exited

cases.injectAt: duplicate, reordered, disconnected, and gapped events
cases.requiredState: idempotent import; retention gap triggers snapshot reconciliation
cases.assertion: cursor and imported sequence match the recovered event set or explicit gap
cases.cleanup: remove isolated event log and database

cases.injectAt: approval is pending while daemon is offline
cases.requiredState: same request ID remains pending until an explicit response
cases.assertion: no executor action follows disconnect without recorded approval
cases.cleanup: resolve or cancel the isolated approval and stop test process

cases.injectAt: result accepted but HTTP response is lost
cases.requiredState: same submission ID returns the original receipt
cases.assertion: business execution count and result receipt count both remain one
cases.cleanup: remove isolated result store and database

cases.injectAt: result submission races with cancellation
cases.requiredState: one transaction order wins; accepted delivery is preserved
cases.assertion: result and cancellation records do not overwrite each other
cases.cleanup: remove isolated database and result artifacts

cases.injectAt: late result from an older attempt arrives
cases.requiredState: audit-only update; current attempt and result remain unchanged
cases.assertion: attempt and execution epoch validation rejects stale settlement
cases.cleanup: remove isolated database and result artifacts

cases.injectAt: result accepted while executor does not exit
cases.requiredState: business result stays accepted; execution remains visible and blocks conflicts
cases.assertion: result state and execution state remain independently queryable
cases.cleanup: verified test process teardown after assertions

cases.injectAt: database control queue full or slow query
cases.requiredState: bounded backpressure while stop and recovery still make progress
cases.assertion: control latency and queue bounds meet the frozen target under load
cases.cleanup: stop load generator and remove isolated database

cases.injectAt: Host log write failure or disk full
cases.requiredState: no false durable acknowledgment; stop path remains available
cases.assertion: failed persistence is surfaced and command is not acknowledged as durable
cases.cleanup: remove isolated disk-pressure fixture

cases.injectAt: one account continuously returns 429
cases.requiredState: that account waits while other accounts progress without business-budget use
cases.assertion: account-scoped cooldown and progress of unaffected account are observed
cases.cleanup: stop isolated fake providers and clear test queue

cases.injectAt: multiple daemons request a fully occupied host budget
cases.requiredState: aggregate reservation stays within limit; recovery does not double grant
cases.assertion: coordinator reports total reservations across daemon identities
cases.cleanup: stop isolated daemons and reset test-only budget service

cases.injectAt: one task, Host, or configuration is invalid
cases.requiredState: local isolation; healthy independent tasks continue
cases.assertion: failure scope and unaffected task progress are both observable
cases.cleanup: remove isolated tasks and test processes

cases.injectAt: runtime configuration or binary changes during execution
cases.requiredState: active execution stays pinned; new execution uses new pin
cases.assertion: digests for active and newly created attempts match their respective versions
cases.cleanup: remove isolated runtime versions and test processes

cases.injectAt: schema migration interrupted, repeated, or opened by an old binary
cases.requiredState: migration resumes idempotently or incompatible binary is explicitly rejected
cases.assertion: schema version, constraints, historical rows, and indexes are verified
cases.cleanup: remove isolated database snapshots

cases.injectAt: restore old database snapshot with newer Host or pending receipt
cases.requiredState: reconciliation completes before admission opens
cases.assertion: new Host facts and pending delivery obligations survive restore reconciliation
cases.cleanup: remove isolated backup and restore directories

cases.injectAt: client synchronous wait times out and repeats query
cases.requiredState: operation continues and remains queryable; timeout does not cancel it
cases.assertion: operation ID and state remain stable across timed-out reads
cases.cleanup: stop isolated test operation through its formal control path

cases.injectAt: high-rate output with a slow UI consumer
cases.requiredState: control stays responsive, buffers stay bounded, consumer can resume
cases.assertion: measured control latency and buffer maximum meet frozen bounds
cases.cleanup: stop output generator and remove isolated event store

cases.injectAt: forced restart races with final usage event
cases.requiredState: usage is neither lost nor counted twice; unsettled usage remains unknown
cases.assertion: usage event identity and settlement completeness survive recovery
cases.cleanup: remove isolated usage ledger and test processes

cases.injectAt: Worker submits delivery while daemon is offline, then exits
cases.requiredState: Host retains RECEIVED responsibility and daemon validates once after reconnect
cases.assertion: offline receipt is not treated as business acceptance and final validation count is one
cases.cleanup: reconnect test Host, settle delivery, and verify test process exit
